descriptions.en: "With the new '99, the Atomicycle project has been reimagined and redefined like never before, improving markedly in all areas: aerodynamics, ergonomics, engine, chassis and electronics. The result is a stellar new form that performs as well on the track as it does drifting through the city; more intuitively and with significantly less fatigue for operators. A must-feel for both pro-riders and amateurs alike." - ZeViLa Inc.
descriptions.zh: "随着新款 '99 的推出，原子摩托车项目得到了前所未有的重新构想和定义，在空气动力学、人体工程学、发动机、底盘和电子设备这些领域都有了显著改进。其结果是，这款全新车型在赛道上与在城市中漂移的表现同样出色；而且更加直观，驾驶者的疲劳度也大大降低。无论对于职业车手还是业余车手，都是必要的。"——泽威拉公司
